scope: Read-only stored GPU metrics plus nativeCPU geometry reconstruction; no physics run. GPU class maxima and packed first event retain exact source timing. Native pre/post geometry does not reconstruct actual GPU contact wrench or all contacts.
timing: states include initial sample: GPU class metric tick t was audited before integration; matching native state is index t, index t+1 is post-integration. Phase belongs to command interval states.phase[t+1]. Actual backend time and scheduled times are both recorded. Original first-event monitor active category is separate from attachment status.
selection_caution: Diagnostic continuation and a fast stopped prefix cannot qualify a complete valid trace. Six-pair negative evidence is bounded to own peak±0.15s; no global no-crossing proof. Guard-policy pass is not a claim of real-plant fidelity or a complete-truss harvest.
